title: Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO Details
intro:
Bombay Coated and Special Steels IPO is a book build issue of ₹183.06 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 2.23 crore shares of ₹183.06 crore.

Bombay Coated and Special Steels IPO opens for subscription on Oct 29, 2026 and closes on Nov 2, 2026. The allotment for the Bombay Coated and Special Steels IPO is expected to be finalized on Nov 3, 2026. Bombay Coated and Special Steels IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Nov 5, 2026.

Bombay Coated and Special Steels IPO is set issue price band at ₹78 to ₹82 per share. The lot size for an application is 182 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,924 (182 shares) (based on upper price).

Smart Horizon Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Bombay Coated and Special Steels IPO RHP for detailed Information.

The Company serves a diversified customer base across consumer durables, home appliances, refrigeration, automotive, electrical equipment, electronics, industrial engineering and other manufacturing sectors. Its customers include OEMs and ODMs such as Haier Appliances India Private Limited, IFB Refrigeration Limited, Dixon Electro Manufacturing Private Limited, Amber Enterprises India Limited and Western Refrigeration Private Limited.

faqs.question: How to apply in Bombay Coated and Special Steels IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Bombay Coated and Special Steels IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Bombay Coated and Special Steels IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Bombay Coated and Special Steels IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Bombay Coated and Special Steels IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.
